description: Select oral and injectable glucose-lowering agents for a newly diagnosed patient with type 2 diabetes using a compelling-indication hierarchy (heart failure → ASCVD → DKD → obesity) followed by glucose-pattern matching. Incorporates modern GLP-1 receptor agonists — Ozempic (semaglutide SC, T2D), Mounjaro (tirzepatide), and Wegovy/Noveltreat (semaglutide 2.4 mg, obesity). Use when a clinician asks "what drug to start for newly diagnosed T2D", "which OAD to use", "first-line diabetes medication", "SGLT2i vs GLP-1 in new T2D", or presents a newly diagnosed T2D patient needing a personalised medication plan.
